name: sgs/info-box
title: SGS Info Box
description: Feature or benefit card with 5 toggleable, reorderable elements: media, title, subtitle, text, and button.

content.label: Card content
content._note: Heading/subtitle/description/button are native InnerBlocks children (HC2/D192 — parent owns LAYOUT, child owns TYPOGRAPHY), each carrying its own typography inspector, so this block declares no text cluster for them. `width` resolves via css:width (render.php `{$root_sel}{width:{$cw_safe};}` — a real `width` declaration, distinct from the separate maxWidth/css:max-width control). RENAMED from `contentWidth` 2026-08-10 per D540: this block renders no inner band, and D540 reserves `contentWidth` for a block that does — a block wanting a fixed width says `width`.

media.label: Icon / media
media._note: Governed by its own mediaType/iconPosition selects — outside the Text/Fill/Layout style clusters. supports.sgs.imageControls removed 2026-08-11 (Spec 35 capability-routing doctrine): this block never renders an /

borderColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the hover border instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over borderColourHover at render time (D636).

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the RESTING border instead of the native __experimentalBorder.color flat colour. Non-empty wins over the native border colour at render time (mirrors the borderColourHoverGradient pattern, D636).

backgroundColour.description: RESTING background colour — block-private replacement for the retired native supports.color.background (D744).

backgroundColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the RESTING background instead of the flat backgroundColour. Non-empty wins over backgroundColour at render time (mirrors the borderColourGradient/borderColourHoverGradient pattern, D636).

textColour.description: RESTING text colour — block-private replacement for the retired native supports.color.text (D744).

textColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the RESTING text colour instead of the flat textColour. Non-empty wins over textColour at render time (background-clip:text).

textColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the HOVER text colour instead of the flat textColourHover. Non-empty wins over textColourHover at render time (background-clip:text).

linkColour.description: RESTING descendant-link colour — block-private replacement for the retired native supports.color.link Elements API (D744).

linkColourGradient.description: Descendant-link colour GRADIENT (background-clip:text). Sibling to linkColour; keeps the link row at the same flat-or-gradient parity as the text row.

linkColourHoverGradient.description: HOVER/focus descendant-link colour GRADIENT. Sibling to linkColourHover.

linkColourHover.description: HOVER/focus descendant-link colour — no native equivalent existed; new sibling to linkColour.
